svg.title: 2035-09-02 total solar eclipse study chart
svg.desc: Numbered shadow-plane cross-section, global UTC contacts and timeline, geometry ledger, and available calculated central-path coordinates.
svg.text: Earth section: center x = 2,380.9 km; radius = 6,378.1 km
Penumbra: center x = 0.0 km; radius = 3,455.1 km
Umbra: center x = 0.0 km; radius = 28.3 km
Offset (km) · origin: shadow axis · +x toward Earth’s center
Both axes use kilometres at the same scale. Transverse orientation is arbitrary; no celestial compass is implied.
A cross-section through Earth’s center at closest axis approach, not the shadow footprint on Earth’s surface.
Global event window: 05h 20m 13s. These are global limits, not local contacts or duration.
Event times are calculated; markers use nearest stored positions. Path limits are central-axis contacts.
200 stored coordinates. Longitude east +; latitude geocentric. Blue: total. Orange: annular. Center line only; no path width.
Original chart and calculations: Star Almanack. Positions: JPL DE440s. Spherical Earth; instantaneous geometry; provisional model.
Surface core extrema describe the sampled surface path; the cross-section core radius describes a different plane.
